idea-plugin.name: Persian RTL for AI Chat
idea-plugin.description:
Right-to-left support for Persian (and Arabic/Hebrew) text in the JetBrains AI Assistant chat.
  • Chat messages (yours and the AI's): each paragraph gets its own direction. A paragraph is RTL and right-aligned when it starts with a Persian letter or is mostly Persian; English text and code stay LTR.
  • The prompt box switches to RTL (direction and alignment) while the prompt is Persian.
  • Optional: mirror the whole chat panel to an RTL layout.
Settings: Settings | Tools | Persian RTL for AI Chat.
